title: ID0414920-DC/Si-D/DK[PEtcz3] - mqtt: pt/statusenquiry/response error after update FW
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Several logs of MQTT error - CCV not initialized
Solution:
Re-initialize the CCV or replace
After update to FW 6.1.3 the charger is having a mqtt error.
SOcr5j did also get the error after update.
